Vehicles from brands like Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, and Lotus are built to exacting standards, and proper service demands more than just general mechanical skill. From advanced diagnostics to complex drivetrain and suspension systems, repairs must be performed with manufacturer-specific techniques and equipment to ensure peak performance and reliability. Whether it’s addressing electronic issues, engine tuning, or sourcing rare OEM parts, exotic European repair is all about preserving the integrity, value, and driving experience of these finely crafted machines. | Diagnostics and Calibration | Repairing a vehicle begins by understanding the problem. Using factory diagnostic equipment and advanced scanners is essential for accurately identifying issues in modern vehicles. These tools interface directly with a car’s onboard systems to read fault codes, monitor real-time data, and perform system-specific tests. For exotic and high-performance cars, factory-level diagnostics ensure precise troubleshooting without guesswork, helping technicians pinpoint problems quickly and efficiently. This technology not only saves time and money but also ensures repairs are done right the first time—preserving performance, reliability, and vehicle integrity. | Engine-outs | Engine-out services for exotic cars are complex procedures that require expert skill, precision, and the right environment. These services involve removing the entire engine from the vehicle to perform major repairs such as head gasket replacement, timing system overhauls, or full engine rebuilds—common on high-performance platforms where space is limited and tolerances are tight. At our facility, these repairs are carried out with exacting care, often within our dedicated clean room, designed to maintain a contaminant-free environment for sensitive engine components. This level of cleanliness and control is crucial when rebuilding exotic powertrains, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and longevity. | A/C | A/C repairs on high-end vehicles require specialized knowledge and equipment due to the complexity and precision of luxury climate control systems. Exotic and high-performance cars often use advanced dual-zone or automatic systems with tightly integrated electronics and sensors. Proper diagnostics and repairs involve more than just recharging refrigerant—they may include detecting leaks, replacing compressors, or recalibrating system controls. Our technicians use manufacturer-specific tools and procedures to ensure your vehicle’s A/C system performs flawlessly, delivering the comfort and refinement expected from a premium driving experience. | Transmission | We specialize in high-performance transmission services tailored for exotic and luxury vehicles. Our team handles everything from precise clutch replacements to full manual transmission rebuilds , using OEM or upgraded performance components to ensure smooth, responsive shifting and long-term reliability. Whether your car is street-driven or track-focused, we restore drivability and performance to factory or better-than-factory standards. | We’re also experts in Ferrari’s F1-style electrohydraulic transmissions , offering specialized diagnostics, actuator repairs, clutch wear calibration, and software tuning for models like the 360, F430, and 599. These advanced systems require in-depth knowledge and exact calibration—something we’ve mastered through years of experience. Whether you're maintaining your Ferrari or pushing it to its limits, we ensure every shift is fast, precise, and perfectly dialed in. | Sticky Buttons | The dreaded "sticky buttons" are one of the most annoying factors of Ferrari ownership. We use multiple vendors to correct the issue and do so in a timely manner, all the while at a competitive cost. | OEM parts | Where available and unless otherwise requested we always use Factory Ferrari parts.
